notes.title: 🎉 Exciting News for Digs Icy Players! 🎮
notes.content:
Get ready to embark on a whole new adventure because we've just dropped a massive update! We're thrilled to announce the addition of 25 brand-new levels to Digs Icy!

🌟 Dive into fresh challenges and explore captivating landscapes as you progress through these exhilarating new stages.

🔥 Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting your journey, there's never been a better time to jump in and experience the thrill of conquering these exciting new levels.

🚀 So gather your friends, sharpen your skills, and prepare for an epic gaming experience like never before!

Update your game now and let the adventure begin! 🎮✨

notes.title: Early Access announcement of Digs
notes.content:
Hi,

Our unique strategy game is now in early access on Steam. We have received an 85% positive review on our prologue version, and we were finalists in the indie showcase.

The game offers a very unique take on the tower defense genre with lots of original mechanics. We have been developing this game for around a year and have been updating it at least once every two weeks based on player feedback.

You can find the game here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2281870/Digs/

Keep digging!!
